Class CharacterCard

java.lang.Object
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.Card
mesos.am30.gameModel.card.CharacterCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CharacterCard extends Card
Representation of a Character Card.
This Class works as the representation for a Character Card, independently of the role of the Character.

  • Constructor Details

    • CharacterCard

      public CharacterCard(int era, int id, Parameter role, Integer value, Integer prestigePoints)
      Constructor of a Character Card.
      Pre: 1 <= era <= 4 && id > 1 && role != null && value != null && prestigePoints != null
      Post: this.era = era && this.id = id && this.role = role && this.value = value && this.prestigePoints = prestigePoints
      Parameters:
      era - Era when the Card is draw.
      id - Unique ID of the Card.
      role - Role of the Character.
      value - Value of the Character attribute (if existing).
      prestigePoints - Value of the Character in prestige points (if existing).
